svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Ubuntu; Linux x86_64; rv:139.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/139.0" version="27.0.6" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="nqfO9UoTSkQT8kRkgrmL"> <mxGraphModel dx="4077" dy="2423" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
!theme vibrant

title Automated Parking Management System - Level 1 DFD

actor Driver
actor ParkingStaff as \"Parking Staff\"

' External Hardware Entities (simplified as interfaces for Level 1)
boundary ANPR_Interface as \"ANPR Camera Interface\"
boundary Proximity_Sensor_Interface as \"Proximity Sensor Interface\"
boundary RFID_Interface as \"RFID Reader/Writer Interface\"
boundary Gate_Interface as \"Gate Control Interface\"
boundary Alarm_Interface as \"Alarm System Interface\"
boundary Dashboard_UI as \"Dashboard Web UI\"
boundary PoS_UI as \"PoS Top-Up UI\"

' Data Stores
database ParkingLogDB as \"Parking Log DB\n(parking_log, transactions, rfid_cards)\"

' Processes
rectangle CheckInProcess as \"1.0\nVehicle Check-In\nAssistance\"
rectangle ANPRProcess as \"1.1\nANPR & OCR\"
rectangle CheckOutProcess as \"2.0\nVehicle Check-Out\nAssistance\"
rectangle PaymentProcess as \"2.1\nRFID Payment\nProcessing\"
rectangle AlertProcess as \"3.0\nAlert Subsystem\"
rectangle DashboardProcess as \"4.0\nDashboard Monitor\"
rectangle PoSProcess as \"5.0\nRFID Card\nTop-Up (PoS)\"

' --- Flows for Check-In ---
Driver --|> Proximity_Sensor_Interface : Vehicle Approach (Entry)
Proximity_Sensor_Interface --> CheckInProcess : Vehicle Detected (Entry)
CheckInProcess --> ANPR_Interface : Trigger Camera (Entry)
ANPR_Interface --> ANPRProcess : Plate Image (Entry)
ANPRProcess --> ParkingLogDB : Plate Number, Entry Timestamp
ANPRProcess --> CheckInProcess : Validated Plate
CheckInProcess --> Gate_Interface : Open Gate Command (Entry)
ParkingLogDB <-- CheckInProcess : Vehicle Entry Log

' --- Flows for Check-Out & Payment ---
Driver --|> Proximity_Sensor_Interface : Vehicle Approach (Exit)
Proximity_Sensor_Interface --> CheckOutProcess : Vehicle Detected (Exit)
CheckOutProcess --> ANPR_Interface : Trigger Camera (Exit)
ANPR_Interface --> ANPRProcess : Plate Image (Exit)
ANPRProcess --> CheckOutProcess : Validated Plate (Exit)

CheckOutProcess --> ParkingLogDB : Query Unpaid Session
ParkingLogDB --> CheckOutProcess : Parking Session Details

CheckOutProcess --> PaymentProcess : Request Payment Verification
Driver --|> RFID_Interface : Present RFID Card (for Payment)
RFID_Interface --> PaymentProcess : RFID Card Data (UID, Plate, Balance)
PaymentProcess --> ParkingLogDB : Query Parking Duration/Fee
ParkingLogDB --> PaymentProcess : Calculated Fee
PaymentProcess --> RFID_Interface : Update Balance Command
PaymentProcess --> ParkingLogDB : Payment Transaction Log
PaymentProcess --> CheckOutProcess : Payment Status (Success/Fail)

CheckOutProcess --> Gate_Interface : Open Gate Command (Exit, if paid)
CheckOutProcess --> AlertProcess : Trigger Alarm (Exit, if unpaid)
ParkingLogDB <-- CheckOutProcess : Vehicle Exit Log Update

' --- Flows for PoS Top-Up ---
ParkingStaff --|> PoS_UI : Top-Up Request (Plate, Amount)
PoS_UI --> PoSProcess : Top-Up Details
Driver --|> RFID_Interface : Present RFID Card (for Top-Up) ' Assume driver/staff for this card presentation
RFID_Interface --> PoSProcess : Card UID (optional, for read before write)
PoSProcess --> RFID_Interface : Write Data Command (Plate, New Balance)
RFID_Interface --> PoSProcess : Write Confirmation
PoSProcess --> ParkingLogDB : RFID Card Balance Update, Top-Up Transaction Log
PoSProcess --> PoS_UI : Top-Up Result

' --- Flows for Alerts ---
AlertProcess --> Alarm_Interface : Activate Siren/Buzzer
AlertProcess --> ParkingLogDB : Incident Log (Unauthorized Exit, Tampering)
' Gate_Interface --> AlertProcess : Tamper Signal (Future enhancement)

' --- Flows for Dashboard ---
DashboardProcess <-- ParkingLogDB : Logs (Entries, Exits, Payments, Alerts)
DashboardProcess --> Dashboard_UI : Real-time Data for Display
ParkingStaff --|> Dashboard_UI : View Dashboard

' --- General Data Flows ---
CheckInProcess .up.> ParkingLogDB : (write)
CheckOutProcess .up.> ParkingLogDB : (read/write)
PaymentProcess .up.> ParkingLogDB : (read/write)
AlertProcess .up.> ParkingLogDB : (write)
PoSProcess .up.> ParkingLogDB : (write)


@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="k6Byu_Kp544TzryiRGrw-1"> <mxCell style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="-1250" y="-430" width="3535" height="1308" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
